prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 24 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1192; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with acute right shoulder pain, restricted range of motion, and difficulty with overhead reaching. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force of the crash, and the clinical picture fits the type of trauma described. Over the course of care, the patient completed 24 visits, consisting of physical therapy, range-of-motion and strengthening exercises, and periodic re-evaluation. Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for this presentation, largely to address persistent stiffness and gradual functional gains. On examination, some findings, including limited active elevation and tenderness over the rotator cuff region, support the reported injury, while other tests, such as neurological screening and stability assessment, remained within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment to this shoulder. Billing records reflect no duplicate or repeated charges for services. Current status is improving, with ongoing home exercise and follow-up as needed.
